QuestInfo.0: #bBeldar#k's ready to tell you about the Blue Dragon Cannon development.
QuestInfo.1: The Dragon Cannon needs a lot of #bAnimal Oil#k items, 50 to be exact. You can get it from #rRed Speeyor#k monsters in #bRed Speeyor's Pasture#k.
QuestInfo.2: You collected enough Animal Oil to help with the Cannon development.

0.0: Cartalion brought you up to speed? Then I'll make this quick.\r\n
